title: Filtering the sales table by text

steps.title: Keep rows where sale_date is 2025-01-12
steps.prompt:
WHERE is a sieve: only rows that pass the test stay.
Text values wear quotes, like '2025-01-12'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT * FROM sales WHERE sale_date = '2025-01-12';
hints: Wrap the text value in single quotes.
Write: SELECT * FROM sales WHERE sale_date = '2025-01-12';

steps.title: Search with LIKE for names starting '202'
steps.prompt:
LIKE searches by pattern using the % wildcard.
202% means 'starts with'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT * FROM sales WHERE sale_date LIKE '202%';
hints: Write: SELECT * FROM sales WHERE sale_date LIKE '202%';
steps.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM sales WHERE sale_date LIKE '202%';

steps.title: Search with LIKE for '025' anywhere
steps.prompt:
Putting % on BOTH sides matches the text anywhere.
This %025% means 'contains'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT * FROM sales WHERE sale_date LIKE '%025%';
hints: Wrap the text in %% on both sides.
Write: SELECT * FROM sales WHERE sale_date LIKE '%025%';
steps.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM sales WHERE sale_date LIKE '%025%';
